firmwares.evidence: PS5 dump of fw 0x04000042 from pid 61: a 4 MiB libSceAvcap2.sprx.prefix.bin with no missing pages plus the SceRemotePlay eboot prefix. Re-checked 2026-10-29: the size store decodes at 0x1b7f12 as mov qword ptr [rdi+0x10], 0x230 and 0x33f is a full Avcap2 prologue (push rbp; mov rbp, rsp; sub rsp, 0x98)
firmwares.notes: The SIMD constructor's RIP-relative constants decode one byte early in this dump; the parser applies a +1 shift only when it yields a complete recognized descriptor pair (rate 0x68/0x20, image 0xe8/0x40), which it does here. mask tail is 0x14 bytes, not 0x24. Exact-only: another 4.00 build is refused
